Q01.summary: Renders a Phlex form section with six labeled trusted-publisher text fields (three optional), each with error styling and help text.

Q02.summary: For a request with a body and empty or url-encoded content type, sets the default content type and yields the body unless it is already a string or IO.

Q03.summary: For a keyword `or` node, flags and autocorrects a missing space before or after the operator keyword.

Q04.summary: Builds a CI diff of added, removed (net of entries matched as renames by trace) and worsened entries whose integer magnitude increased.

Q05.summary: Turns the chosen YAML config file's validated settings into a list of CLI flag/value pairs, resolving --config/--no-config and erroring on bad files or values.

Q06.summary: Returns the inner statements of a single opened root node's body, or the roots themselves otherwise.

Q07.summary: Builds an OIDC access policy with one allow statement per workflow ref extracted from the JWT, each combining repository, environment, owner id, audience and job_workflow_ref conditions.

Q08.summary: Configures the middleware stack (yielding self or defaulting to url_encoded) and sets the default adapter if none, raising if the stack is locked.

Q09.summary: Returns this version's checksums (or content keys) that do not appear in any other version's checksums file for the gem.

Q10.summary: CLI entry that loads a kimera report and either shows one mutant by id or lists mutants with a status (default survived) optionally filtered by file, returning an exit code.

Q11.summary: Finds the RuboCop config path by checking project dotfile, project .config, user dotfile, XDG config, then the default.

Q12.summary: Walks the method body tallying calls per local receiver (and self), returning the most-used receivers unless self ties for most used (feature envy).

Q13.summary: Returns provenance hash saying whether the test files were narrowed from the configured tests, including the configured tests when narrowed.

Q14.summary: Keeps only variants whose rewritten AST outcome at the location differs from all earlier kept variants.

Q15.summary: If the mutation point is still safe and its location lies inside one of the ranges, marks it unsafe with that range's reason; returns self.

Q16.summary: Hash-like fetch that, for an unset key, assigns the default argument or block result, or raises key-not-found, then returns the value.

Q17.summary: Decodes a query string with the given or default encoder and merges its params into self with string keys.

Q18.summary: Picks the lowest-ranked edges whose removal keeps the largest strongly connected group at most half the members, then drops edges not needed for that.

Q19.summary: Returns the URL's path with a leading slash plus its query parameters sorted.

Q20.summary: True when the user owns gems recommending MFA, lacks a strong MFA level and is not MFA-required, and has MFA disabled.

Q21.summary: Returns a new Local storage rooted at a subdirectory, raising if the path escapes the base directory.

Q22.summary: Logs the request method and filtered URL, plus headers and body when configured, at the configured log level.

Q23.summary: Fetches a task from the RSTUF API and returns its data state, raising on failure.

Q24.summary: Temporarily restricts RSpec's filtered examples and group children to the wanted examples' lineage while running the block, then restores them.

Q25.summary: Parses a raw header string, taking only the last response's headers and adding each, joining duplicate keys with commas.

Q26.summary: Collects strings/symbols from array literals and hash-literal keys in the tree that match PATTERN, as a set.

Q27.summary: Recursively checks that the node's type is a literal value type and all its children are literal too.

Q28.summary: Says whether the usage can be split into at least two parts (a common shared-constants part and connected client groups) that meet size and weight minimums.

Q29.summary: Renders the password reset form, requiring MFA first unless verified or compromised, marking verification and setting the compromised flag.

Q30.summary: Records WebAuthn MFA login duration and signs the user in, tracking success (events, flash, redirect) or failure (tracking, re-render login).

Q31.summary: Flags if/ternary/elsif with literal true/false branches and autocorrects to the (possibly negated) condition.

Q32.summary: Flags nested ternaries inside a ternary and autocorrects the outer ternary into an if/else.

Q33.summary: Adds test roots to the load path, requires the test files and re-indexes Minitest runnable methods by name.

Q34.summary: Creates a request of the given method with copies of the connection's params, headers and options, yielding it for customization.

Q35.summary: Recursively collects condition nodes that steer control flow, stopping at scope fences and skipping and/or nodes carried by their parent.

Q36.summary: Returns the coupling graph from a lazily built coupling report, resolving :auto packaging to namespace for Rails or folder otherwise.

Q37.summary: Loads the ignore rules from a baseline YAML relative to the config file, symbolizing keys and requiring each to have a file and reason.

Q38.summary: Builds a Folding over catalog entries excluding Rails presentation files, with Rails suffixes when in a Rails project.

Q39.summary: URL-encodes params (hash or array), optionally sorted, recursively encoding nested hashes and arrays with bracket keys.

Q40.summary: Asks the lazily built placement (from the definitions catalog) whether a package is web.

Q41.summary: Builds a timeout MutantResult for the mutant with its file and a watchdog detail plus optional stacks.

Q42.summary: Expands the CLI or configured or default globs into sorted .rb files, minus excluded files and patterns.

Q43.summary: Flags initialize methods that are empty without args or only call super with the same args, autocorrecting by removal.

Q44.summary: Recursively collects byte-offset spans of the bodies of hole-type nodes in a syntax tree.

Q45.summary: Runs the worker pool event loop: bootstraps workers, assigns ids, polls pipes for messages, handles results/requeues/timeouts until no workers remain, then disbands.

Q46.summary: Signals a process to dump stacks and waits up to a grace period for its dump file, returning and deleting its contents (or a placeholder), or nil if the process is gone.

Q47.summary: Flags single-line `in` pattern branches not using `then` and autocorrects the separator to ` then`.

Q48.summary: Runs the mutant ids serially or concurrently with progress reporting, returning a RunReport.

Q49.summary: Checks `end` alignment of a case expression, using assignment-aware alignment targets when the case is an assigned value.

Q50.summary: Verifies and saves a new WebAuthn credential, responding with a redirect URL (recovery codes if first device) or a JSON error, and clears the registration session.

Q51.summary: Flags a for loop following another over the same collection and autocorrects by merging their bodies.

Q52.summary: Scores each method's cognitive complexity across trees and returns findings for those at or above the threshold, sorted highest first.

Q53.summary: Forks a coverage worker child with request/response pipes and returns its pid, parent-side pipes and stack dumper.

Q54.summary: Rack middleware that signs in the user given by the `as` query param before calling the app.

Q55.summary: Flags multiline ternaries and autocorrects them to a single-line ternary or if/else, preserving comments in the condition.

Q56.summary: Classifies how two node sequences differ: structure if types differ, otherwise the distinct categories of differing node pairs.

Q57.summary: Returns a hash of status, body, headers and URL for marshaling if the response is finished, otherwise nil.

Q58.summary: Collects class/module sketches from all trees and settles each with lineage, kinship protocol and ownership info.

Q59.summary: Flags `when` conditions in a case that are float expressions, except zero or nil literals.

Q60.summary: Runs the test suite as a baseline and, if green with multiple jobs, runs parallel shards too, returning status/message pairs for each.
